first_page_excerpt: TPS7A02 SBVS277C – JULY 2019 – REVISED SEPTEMBER 2022 TPS7A02 Nanopower IQ, 25-nA, 200-mA, Low-Dropout Voltage Regulator With Fast Transient Response 1 Features 3 Description • • • The TPS7A02 is an ultra-small, ultra-low quiescent current low-dropout linear regulator (LDO) that can source 200 mA with excellent transient performance. • • • • • • The TPS7A02, with an ultra-low IQ of 25 nA, is designed specifically for applications where very-low quiescent current is a critical parameter.
